about_the_game:
Make Tracks Great Again：

  • This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again.

    There is only one goal: make money, make money, make money. You need to earn more each time.

    How to make money?: Dispatch a train of the corresponding color to the platform based on the cargo color of the truck, wait until the train is fully loaded and departs. You'll earn a huge sum once the train leaves.

    If: No train matching the cargo color is available at the platform, the truck will leave with the cargo, resulting in a massive fine.

——————————————————————————————————————————————

Once, this railway station stood as the greatest, most profitable, and most incredible transportation hub in the nation—without equal!

For decades it operated in glorious efficiency, with cities daily vying to pack our freight cars to the brim. The volume of orders back then was so overwhelming that the rails nearly buckled under the strain!

Then one day—no one understood why—certain individuals began destroying it all with catastrophically poor decisions!

Now?

Our debts now outnumber the bolts on these rails, and liquidation agents are smirking on the platforms, calculators in hand!

How Many Steps to Fit an Elephant into a Refrigerator?

  • No.1:Lift the barrier gate to allow the truck access to the station

  • No.2:Select a train matching the cargo’s color

  • No.3:Wait for the cargo to be loaded

  • No.4:Wait for the train to be fully loaded and depart the station




    Simple, right?

  • Tasks required: Select trains matching the cargo’s color, allocate trains on the tracks appropriately, control the opening and closing of barrier gates, and manage trucks entering the station.

    BUT!!!

     Trucks departing with cargo will cause significant losses to the station!!!
     

    Hold on：

  • "Listen up, rookie. You’re the new acting stationmaster now, and this is an ‘absolutely simple’ job! Use your astonishing talents to make tracks great again!



    (Trust me, everyone who’s ever believed in me calls this the greatest slogan in history.) Before you, 73 acting agents briefly restored the station to glory—for about five minutes. And then?
    This place ended up buried under new debt! Guess what happened to those losers?
    Oh, and right now, dozens of self-proclaimed ‘genius’ agents are working in other offices, competing against you in real time. So, which of you will prove to be the top agent?"—Boss

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 , AMD Equivalent configuration
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti , AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600, AMD Equivalent configuration
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 , AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.
